PRAVIN BARBADE Pune, India | +91 9325285041 | pbarbade87@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Securities Services and Operational Risk professional with 19+ years of experience across Custody Operations, Fund Accounting, Corporate Actions, Reconciliation and Operational Risk & Controls within BNY Mellon. Experienced in Operational Risk Event (ORE) reviews, Risk Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), risk and control reviews, control-gap identification, remediation tracking, KRI monitoring, regulatory reporting and risk governance. Proven ability to partner with Risk, Compliance, Technology, Product, Operations and First Line of Defence (1LOD) stakeholders to identify and mitigate operational risks, strengthen control environments and support audit and regulatory requirements. Strong Securities Services foundation spanning Custody, Fund Accounting, Corporate Actions, cash/position reconciliation and post-trade processing, complemented by team leadership, process governance and control improvement experience.

CORE EXPERTISE

Risk & Controls: Operational Risk Management | ORE Reviews | RCSA | Risk & Control Reviews | Control-Gap Identification | Remediation Tracking | KRI Monitoring | Control Effectiveness Review & Reporting

Securities Services: Custody Operations | Fund Accounting | Corporate Actions | Trade Settlement | Cash & Position Reconciliation | Custodial Reconciliation | Post-Trade Processing | Sub-Custodian Operations

Governance & Regulatory: Regulatory & Non-Financial Regulatory Reporting | Risk Governance | Audit Support | Issue & Exception Management | Management Reporting | Risk Escalation | Control Documentation

Process & Transformation: Process Improvement | Risk-Control Automation | BRD | UAT | Functional Testing | Process Standardization | Knowledge Transfer

Leadership & Stakeholders: Team Leadership | 1LOD / Risk / Compliance / Technology / Product Collaboration | Stakeholder Management | Training & Mentoring

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

BNY Mellon (I) Pvt. Ltd. | Pune VP – Operational Risk & Reporting | 2024 – 2026

OPERATIONAL RISK & REPORTING

Performed advanced post-submission validation and analysis to identify and resolve issues related to regulatory reporting. • Prepared and submitted complex non-financial regulatory reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness and timeliness. • Acted as a key coordination point for partner units on reporting exceptions, discrepancies and clarifications. • Collaborated with Risk, Compliance, Technology and Product teams to support integrated reporting solutions and resolve operational issues.

Supported governance forums by preparing status updates, reporting materials, issue summaries and management information.

Supported internal and external audits through detailed analysis, documentation and evidence preparation.

OPERATIONAL RISK EVENT (ORE) REVIEWS

Performed detailed ORE reviews covering source documentation, control failures, root causes, impact assessment, corrective actions and supporting evidence.

Supported Risk Management Platform (RMP) activities, including review of risk-event data, reporting outputs, event status, documentation and control-related information.

Reviewed ORE rejection trends, identified recurring issues and root causes, and recommended process improvements to reduce recurring deficiencies.

Supported RCSA and risk-control reviews by evaluating key processes, identifying control points and linking control activities with operational risk events.

Worked closely with First Line of Defence (1LOD) teams to review risk events, challenge control-related documentation and ensure appropriate remediation actions were identified.

Prepared and reviewed management reports covering operational risk events, control effectiveness, rejection trends, process

exceptions and improvement opportunities.

Provided training and knowledge transfer on ORE reviews, source-document assessment and control review processes.

RISK-CONTROL AUTOMATION / TRANSFORMATION

Pravin Barbade | Securities Services • Operational Risk & Controls

• Supported automation of a risk-management checklist using an AI agent to reduce manual effort and improve review

consistency.

Prepared BRD requirements for automation of ORE source-documentation review. • Completed UAT testing for the RMP application and translated business requirements for technology teams.

BNY Mellon (I) Pvt. Ltd. | Pune Specialist – Operational Risk & Reporting | 2021 – 2024

Supported operational risk and control activities across Securities Services, including risk identification, control reviews, RCSA and operational risk reporting.

Performed analysis of operational risk events, reviewing control failures, root causes, impacts and corrective actions. • Monitored risk indicators and operational risk trends, escalating issues and supporting remediation activities. • Coordinated with Risk, Compliance and business stakeholders on risk reviews, governance requirements and operational issues.

Supported regulatory and non-financial regulatory reporting through data validation, exception analysis and stakeholder coordination.

Contributed to risk governance reporting, management information and process-improvement initiatives.

BNY Mellon (I) Pvt. Ltd. | Pune Team Leader – Fund Accounting (US Market) | 2015 – 2021

Led Fund Accounting operations for the US market, overseeing day-to-day delivery, reconciliations, operational controls and stakeholder requirements.

Performed cash, portfolio and capital-activity reconciliations and investigated exceptions to support accurate and timely fund accounting.

Identified operational risk areas, developed process controls to mitigate identified risks, and monitored KRIs with action plans for

threshold breaches.

Maintained KRIs and implemented action plans when thresholds were exceeded, supporting proactive risk management. • Reviewed NAV packages, investor allocations, management fees and carried-interest calculations across month-end and quarter-end activities.

Prepared daily, weekly and monthly management information and performed data-quality analysis with timely escalation of issues.

Led process-improvement initiatives including BRD preparation, functional testing, cost-benefit analysis and implementation coordination.

Managed team performance, training and development while promoting process discipline and control awareness.

BNY Mellon (I) Pvt. Ltd. | Pune Senior Analyst – Reference / Master Data Management – Fund Accounting | 2010 – 2015

Managed reference-data activities supporting Fund Accounting, ensuring corporate actions and bond calls were updated and validated within required timelines.

Performed data reconciliation and validation, assessed impact on NAV calculations and escalated discrepancies to responsible teams.

Maintained KPI metrics, issue logs, exception logs and SOPs, supporting process control, issue escalation and action-plan tracking.

Ensured daily checklist completion and supported audit requirements, stakeholder queries and issue resolution. • Liaised with external vendors and internal stakeholders on data-related queries and operational exceptions.

BNY Mellon (I) Pvt. Ltd. | Pune Analyst / SME – Corporate Actions (UK Market) | 2006 – 2010

Managed Corporate Actions processing for the UK market, ensuring events were accurately and timely accounted for in accordance with established procedures.

Processed SWIFT event declarations and payment confirmations received from sub-custodians and performed related client- account activities.

Reconciled client positions against market positions and investigated cash and stock breaks, ensuring timely resolution. • Processed UK Government Treasuries and supported trade settlement of money-market instruments and Treasury notes. • Prepared daily, weekly and monthly management reports and resolved client queries relating to cash events and bond interest.

Gati Ltd. | Pune Revenue Assurance Officer | 2004 – 2006

Pravin Barbade | Securities Services • Operational Risk & Controls

• Performed customer-account reconciliations, revenue assurance, MIS reporting and exception follow-up to support accurate

financial processing.

Kelga Techno Sales Pvt. Ltd. | Pune Junior Executive – Accounts | 2001 – 2002

Handled accounts payable/receivable activities, vendor and customer reconciliations, bank reconciliations and financial reporting support.

EDUCATION

MBA (Finance) – Bharati Vidyapeeth, Shivaji University, 2004 • B.Com. – Garware College of Commerce, Pune University, 2000 • ICWAI – Inter Group II, Institute of Cost Accountants of India, 2014

PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS

Operational Risk Management (ORM) – PRMIA, 2024 • PRINCE2 Practitioner, 2019 • International Introduction to Securities & Investment – CISI, UK, 2014 • NCFM – Capital Market Dealer, NSE, 2006 • Generative AI Certification

TECHNOLOGY & SYSTEMS

Custody / Securities Systems: InvestOne | IAX | CMS | IAS | Geneva | Eagle | Mainframe | SmartStream | SWIFT |

Workbench | PSS | DTCC | CREST

Market Data / Reporting: Bloomberg | IDC | Thomson Reuters | Telekurs | MS Office | Tableau | Hyperion
